statement: Assume that dxG ̸= 0 off A and that, at every point of A, |Gu(x, u)| ∥dxG(x, u)∥ −→ 0 as (x, u) −→ A, x ̸= 0. (8) 32 For each a = 1, i, suppose that X∗ carries a smooth real vector field va = (wa, a) with the following properties: 1. dG(va) = 0 and wa(x, u) → 0 on approach to every point of A; 2. no trajectory of va in X∗ has a finite-time endpoint in A lying inside the representative, in either time direction. Then, after shrinking, there is an ambient homeomorphism germ H(x, u) = (Hu(x), u), G(Hu(x), u) = G(x, 0), Hu(0) = 0, with H0 = id and with H and H−1 jointly continuous.
